title: Tariffs Explained with Bananas
summary: Cartoon explainer of tariffs: importers pay the tax, imported and local prices rise, governments collect revenue, trading partners retaliate, and small import-dependent businesses suffer.

assertions.quote: Banana land banana price usually stay the same, but now Monkeyland monkeys also have to pay Monkeyland government to buy them.
Local price can also go up to just under banana land banana.
So if tariffs make everything more expensive, why do we even have them?
Some monkey businesses import other things from banana land to help run business. Tariffs make these more expensive.
Banana Land government can retaliate. Then Monkeyland could retaliate. Then Banana Land. This is called a trade war.

verdicts.note: Every major US tariff round since 2018 drew matching retaliation from China, the EU, Canada and others.

assertions.quote: Monkeyland government makes money every time monkeys import bananas from banana land.
